z|sub_aj_subastas_explica: Blocks the page's own auction program (Prebid.js, Amazon's apstag, Google Ad Manager) and the syncing of your identifier between companies. If a page needs it, allow it for that site from the side summary. Auctions a site runs from its own servers can't be blocked from here.
z|sub_aj_gpc_explica: Tells every site you don't want your data sold or shared (the Sec-GPC: 1 header and navigator.globalPrivacyControl). It is legally binding in about 12 US states; elsewhere it is a request.
z|sub_aj_ruido: A different fingerprint on every site
z|sub_aj_ruido_explica: Other companies' scripts read slightly different canvas, audio and graphics card values on each site and in each session, so they can't link your visits. The page you open is never touched.
z|sub_aj_uniforme_explica: Every site sees the same common values: a standard screen size, 4 processors, 8 GB of memory, one language, no motion or light sensors, no battery and a generic graphics card. Some pages may look or work differently. What stays real: the time zone, the pixel ratio, the installed fonts and your IP address. Applies to tabs opened after you turn it on.
z|sub_aj_ubicacion: Location: without your permission, a site only learns your country or region from your IP address.
